episode_title: He Handed Over 13 Years of Work for $100K w/ Alan Underwood
question: How did Alan Underwood grow his car dealership to $60 million in revenue before selling it in 2020?
transcript_excerpt: By 2020, Underwood had built the dealership to two locations with about 30 employees, over 30,000 Facebook followers, and over $16 million in annual sales. He grew the business a million dollars year over year for 13 consecutive years after starting in May 2007, though he ultimately sold it after experiencing serious personal losses that affected his ability to operate.

episode_title: He Handed Over 13 Years of Work for $100K w/ Alan Underwood
question: Why did Alan Underwood sell his $60 million car dealership for only $100,000?
transcript_excerpt: Underwood sold the business for approximately $100,000 to a friend after suffering major personal losses—his mother-in-law died of cancer in 2018, his father-in-law in 2019, and his father had a massive stroke in 2020. These losses led to depression and a collapse in his self-worth, causing him to undervalue the business he had built and simply want to exit quickly without contracts or formal negotiation.

episode_title: He Handed Over 13 Years of Work for $100K w/ Alan Underwood
question: What was Alan Underwood's first Angel Flight West mission and why did he start flying for the charity?
transcript_excerpt: Underwood's first flight was for an 18-year-old named Bradley diagnosed with Hodgkin's lymphoma who needed treatment at a children's hospital five hours away. Bradley's mother had been driving three times a week (over 30 hours weekly), but Underwood's one-and-a-half hour flight each way was free to the family. After obtaining his pilot's license and seeking ways to help others through flying, Underwood discovered Angel Flight West and joined the organization.

episode_title: He Handed Over 13 Years of Work for $100K w/ Alan Underwood
question: How many volunteers and missions does Angel Flight West operate annually across Western U.S. states?
transcript_excerpt: Angel Flight West has approximately 2,000 volunteer pilots across 13 Western states and completes 4,000 to 5,000 missions every year, providing non-emergency medical flights to people in need at no cost to the families.

episode_title: He Handed Over 13 Years of Work for $100K w/ Alan Underwood
question: What key steps did Alan Underwood take to rebuild his life after selling his car dealership?
transcript_excerpt: Underwood's first critical step was choosing not to end his life when he was in crisis. He then got clear on his identity outside of business success, spent time in prayer and meditation to forgive himself, joined a paid mastermind group connecting him with 300-400 like-minded entrepreneurs, and hired a business coach who helped him rebuild his mindset and belief in himself rather than just business strategy.
